function.name: get_account_balance
function.description: Retrieves the current balance for a specified bank account. This can include checking, savings, or credit card accounts.

account_id.description: The unique identifier for the bank account.

function.name: transfer_funds
function.description: Initiates a transfer of funds from one account to another within the same banking institution or to an external account.

source_account_id.description: The ID of the account from which funds will be transferred.

destination_account_id.description: The ID of the account to which funds will be transferred.

amount.description: The amount of money to transfer.

memo.description: An optional memo or description for the transaction.

is_external_transfer.description: Indicates if the destination account is external to the current banking institution.

function.name: get_transaction_history
function.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for a specified account within a given date range. Allows filtering by transaction type.

account_id.description: The unique identifier for the bank account.

start_date.description: The start date for the transaction history (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: The end date for the transaction history (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return.

function.name: create_new_account
function.description: Creates a new bank account for an existing customer. Supports various account types like checking, savings, or credit cards.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer.

account_type.description: The type of account to create (e.g., 'checking', 'savings', 'credit_card').

currency.description: The primary currency for the new account (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR').

initial_deposit_amount.description: Optional initial deposit amount for the new account.

function.name: update_contact_information
function.description: Updates the contact details (e.g., email, phone number, address) for a specific customer.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer whose contact information is being updated.

email.description: New email address for the customer.

phone_number.description: New phone number for the customer.

address_line_1.description: First line of the new mailing address.

city.description: City for the new mailing address.

zip_code.description: Zip code for the new mailing address.

function.name: set_card_status
function.description: Changes the status of a debit or credit card, allowing it to be activated, deactivated, or reported as lost/stolen.

card_id.description: The unique identifier for the card.

status.description: The new status for the card (e.g., 'active', 'inactive', 'lost', 'stolen').

reason.description: An optional reason for the status change, especially for 'lost' or 'stolen' statuses.

function.name: search_log_entries
function.description: Searches through log entries based on various criteria such as timestamp range, log level, and keywords. This tool helps in filtering a large volume of logs to find specific events or patterns.

start_timestamp.description: The start timestamp for the search range (ISO 8601 format).

end_timestamp.description: The end timestamp for the search range (ISO 8601 format).

log_level.description: The severity level of the log entry (e.g., INFO, WARN, ERROR, DEBUG).

keywords.description: Keywords to search within the log messages, separated by commas.

source_application.description: The name of the application that generated the log entry.

max_results.description: The maximum number of log entries to return.

function.name: get_log_summary
function.description: Provides a high-level summary of log activities for a specified period, including counts of different log levels and common error types. This helps in quickly understanding the overall health and issues within a system.

start_timestamp.description: The start timestamp for the summary period (ISO 8601 format).

end_timestamp.description: The end timestamp for the summary period (ISO 8601 format).

application_name.description: Filter summary by a specific application name.

function.name: create_alert_rule
function.description: Creates a new alert rule that triggers when specific log patterns or thresholds are met. This allows for proactive monitoring and notification of critical events.

rule_name.description: A unique name for the alert rule.

log_level_threshold.description: The minimum log level that triggers the alert (e.g., ERROR, WARN).

keyword_pattern.description: A regex pattern or keyword to match in log messages.

time_window_minutes.description: The time window in minutes over which to evaluate the threshold.

occurrence_threshold.description: The number of occurrences within the time window to trigger the alert.

recipient_email.description: Email address to send alert notifications to.

function.name: get_alert_rule_status
function.description: Retrieves the current status and configuration of an existing alert rule. This helps in verifying if an alert is active and correctly configured.

rule_id.description: The unique ID of the alert rule to check.

function.name: update_log_retention_policy
function.description: Updates the log retention policy for a specific application or globally. This controls how long log data is stored before being automatically deleted.

application_name.description: The name of the application for which to update the policy. If not provided, applies globally.

retention_days.description: The number of days to retain log entries. Must be a positive integer.

archive_before_delete.description: If true, logs will be archived before deletion.

function.name: get_anomalies_in_logs
function.description: Identifies unusual patterns or anomalies in log data over a specified time frame. This tool is useful for detecting potential system issues or security breaches that deviate from normal behavior.

start_timestamp.description: The start timestamp for the anomaly detection period (ISO 8601 format).

end_timestamp.description: The end timestamp for the anomaly detection period (ISO 8601 format).

application_name.description: Filter anomalies for a specific application.

sensitivity_level.description: The sensitivity level for anomaly detection (e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high').
